verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only client-side meeting capabilities: creating a meeting session in the client application, media limits, and data messages. Nothing describes a server-side API for listing sessions, muting or removing attendees, or ending a meeting. The serverless demo link has no description of such operations, so the story stays unevidenced even though the axis clearly applies to a real-time communications SDK.

support.subject: As a developer, a server-side API lets me list sessions, mute or remove participants, and end a session without a client in the loop
